description:
Scope: cover lib/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing.ex missed lines 37, 42, 51, 60, 76, 101, 188, 189, 194. Exclusive test path to ADD: test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing_test.exs. No changes to production, docs, support files or existing tests. @moduledoc owns BO Person routing construction, display and lookup; this is test-only. Action reuse assessment: not applicable: no operation or execution boundary changes; tests call existing PersonRouting, AgentRouting, IncomingMessageRouting, Repo and NodeRouter contracts. No Action/tool/workflow additions or new consumers. Existing test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/people_live_test.exs:787-950 already exercises successful global, provider, retrieval and mailbox persistence through UI; do not repeat full LiveView flows. No new feature E2E: existing helper behavior only, no changed UX/journey.

Tests to add before implementation (there is no production implementation): use Zaq.DataCase, async: true, alias ZaqWeb.Live.BO.System.PersonRouting; Person, PersonChannel, ChannelConfig, RetrievalChannel, AgentRouting, IncomingMessageRouting. Assert caller-observable return/persistence rather than private function invocations. Use one entry in each choice map so iteration order cannot affect errors.

A. Nil scope values: assert person_global_agent_value(nil) == "" (42); person_provider_agent_value(nil, %ChannelConfig{id: 1}) == "" (51); person_retrieval_agent_value(nil, %RetrievalChannel{id: 1}) == "" (60); person_topic_agent_value(nil, %ChannelConfig{id: 1}, "INBOX") == "" (76). No DB data/query required. Missing identity never confers permission.
B. Non-channel fallback: assert person_channel_routing_configs(nil) == [] and, optionally, person_channel_routing_configs(%{}) == [] (101). Do not mistake %PersonChannel{platform: ...} for the fallback; that invokes a real config query.
C. Malformed provider config key with otherwise valid sentinel: maybe_persist_channel_routing_rules(person.id, %{"provider_agent_ids" => %{"not-an-id" => AgentRouting.none_value()}}) must return {:error, :invalid_routing_choice}. AgentRouting.validate_choice/1 accepts NONE; ParseUtils.parse_int_strict/1 returns bare :error; reduce_choice_map's wildcard at 189 maps it to :invalid_routing_choice; 194 returns the error, and public case line 37 propagates it. Assert no new scope rule was persisted; optionally use an existing persisted unrelated rule to assert it remains unchanged. Do not expect {:error, :error}: that tuple cannot emerge from the provider builder for this input.
D. Explicit tuple error: maybe_persist_channel_routing_rules(person.id, %{"provider_agent_ids" => %{"1" => "bad-agent-choice"}}) returns {:error, :invalid_agent} through 188, 194 and 37: validation fails before config lookup. Distinct case: %{"retrieval_agent_ids" => %{"not-an-id" => AgentRouting.none_value()}} returns {:error, :invalid_retrieval_channel} via retrieval builder's else and 188; malformed topic config key %{"topic_agent_ids" => %{"not-an-id" => %{"INBOX" => AgentRouting.none_value()}}} returns {:error, :invalid_topic_rule} through topic reducer and 37 (not through reduce_choice_map's 188/189). Assert no persisted routing mutation for each. Optionally test existing but absent numeric retrieval ID to cover Repo.get returning nil, without assuming a specific DB sequence.

Fixtures/helpers and isolation: for persistence checks create one real Person via People.create_person/1 with unique email/full name (mirror private PeopleLiveTest person_fixture pattern, do not call/import private helper). Where possible use just a constructed %Person{id: unique_id} and inspect an existing known scope; a real Person is preferable if asserting DB rows. Avoid irrelevant ChannelConfig/agent fixtures for negative paths. DataCase SQL Sandbox provides independent transactions, async safe; no global state, Mox, mocked internal module, external network, process coordination, sleep or polling. Validation errors return before dispatch, so do not stub NodeRouter; successful dispatch integration remains covered by PeopleLiveTest. If a routing rule is arranged for non-mutation assertion, insert via existing public IncomingMessageRouting context and assert exact scope/mode afterward. No production test-only seam.

Property assessment: discrete nil guard and distinct malformed-key/error-result branches have small finite input space; examples give better confidence than property generation. If future scope includes arbitrary malformed choice maps, consider bounded StreamData property that rejected inputs never persist, alongside examples; do not create a broad property just for numeric coverage.

Unreachable/blockers: none established for listed lines. Line 189 is reachable from bare :error for malformed provider key; it is NOT equivalent to line 188's {:error, reason} case. If a proposed persistence assertion requires a missing sandbox owner under actual dispatch, investigate ownership rather than relaxing assertions; these negative cases should not dispatch. No architectural change expected.

When implemented, run isolated mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing_test.exs then mix q via Context Mode; after approved implementation review generate fresh mix coveralls.json then mix coverup per WORKFLOW_AGENT Phase 6, record remaining coverage exceptions in this issue; run final mix precommit via Context Mode before final human approval. No tests, coverage commands, or git changes during planning. Documentation to update: none; put eventual validation evidence in Beadwork. Single root issue; no dependencies.

comments.text: Implemented the planned test-only coverage in test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing_test.exs: nil display guards, non-channel fallback, malformed provider/retrieval/topic keys, invalid provider choice, and no-persistence checks. Validation: targeted mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing_test.exs passed (6 tests, 0 failures), serialized with the required flock. No production, support, documentation, or other test files changed.
